note: The voiceover script, one entry per line. 'say' is what the voice reads (the brand is spelled 'Custom Domain' so it is read as two words); 'gap' is the silence after the line in seconds. scripts/vo_build.py synthesizes each line, places it, and writes the line marks into timeline.json, so the picture is timed to the voice.

lines.say: Every app that lets customers bring their own domain has this button.
What happens after the click decides whether they ever go live.
Your customers can buy a domain from over a hundred different websites.
And most of them use more than one.
A shop here. A blog there. An old idea from years ago.
Today, that click usually hands your customer a list of DNS records. And a job.
First, remember where the domain was bought.
Then leave your app and sign in somewhere else. Forgot the password? Reset it.
Hunt through the menus for the DNS settings.
Copy every record by hand, exactly right.
Then wait, and hope.
One wrong character, and the domain never connects. That's where customers give up, or open a support ticket.
Custom Domain takes all of that off their plate.
Same app. Same button. They type their domain once.
We automatically detect where the domain is managed.
Then, without leaving your app, they sign in to that provider, and approve once.
That's it for your customer.
Behind the scenes, we add the exact DNS records, check that they resolve, and issue the HTTPS certificate.
The domain is live. Connected correctly, the first time.
And we keep it that way. We check it every hour, and renew certificates before they expire.
Seven steps across two websites, or one sign-in that never leaves your app.
Custom Domain. Your customers should never touch DNS.
